lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Volcano Spa & Resort! Five stars! The reviews say "transformative", "life-changing", and "please send help, this is not a review".

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Why does the kingdom need us HERE?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Nobody who checks in ever checks out. The spa says that's "guest retention". The families say it's "kidnapping". Semantics! Onward!

lines.speaker: Concierge
lines.text: Welcome. Your suite is ready. Your FOREVER suite.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We're just passing through.

lines.speaker: Concierge
lines.text: Nobody... passes through. There is a package for that, and you cannot afford it.
The penthouse. The floor is warm. The floor is TOO warm. The floor is the boss.

lines.speaker: Caldera
lines.text: Checking out early incurs a fee. The fee is combat. We take violence and all major currencies.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: What if we leave a good review?

lines.speaker: Caldera
lines.text: Five stars is the MINIMUM. It is also insufficient. ERUPTION PACKAGE, ACTIVATED.

lines.speaker: Caldera
lines.text: Very well... checkout... approved... minibar charges... waived...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The guests are free! Look at them stampede toward the exit in their robes! MAJESTIC.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I kept the slippers.
In the treatment room, a line of magmites waits reverently. On the heated table: a familiar rock.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Warm Rock has been hired as the resort's master hot-stone therapist. He has a waiting list. He has a TITLE.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: He's the best of us.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: He's asked for five minutes at the end of the chapter to just... be warm. Granted, obviously.

lines.speaker: Bikram
lines.text: WELCOME TO MY 104-DEGREE DOMAIN. WE BEGIN IN CHILD'S POSE. WE END IN DRAGON'S POSE. THERE IS NO SAVASANA.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: No corpse pose?!

lines.speaker: Bikram
lines.text: THE CORPSE POSE IS EARNED.
The penthouse elevator plays lava-lamp music. The floor indicator says: TOP. Then: TOO FAR. Then: MANAGER.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Remember: we are CHECKING OUT. Not negotiating. Not upgrading. If he offers the eruption package, the answer is no.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What if it's complimentary?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: NOTHING HERE IS COMPLIMENTARY. WE LEARNED THAT AT THE MINIBAR.
